id.description: The absolute path of the file, or of the folder of a skill. It joins the column path of chat_session_files.

codingAgent.description: Only Claude Code has a folder of subagents.

scope.description: PROJECT: the item applies to the repository only. USER: it applies to every repository of the developer.

folder.description: The absolute path of the folder that holds the item.

name.description: The field name of the header of the file, else the name of the file or of the folder.

description.description: The field description of the header of the file, or null.

createdAt.description: The date of the creation of the file.

updatedAt.description: The date of the last change of the file, or the date of the removal.

removedAt.description: The date of the first synchronization that did not find the file any more, or null when the file is there.
